title: Utopia region renamed Galaxias Chaos after the second face

tellings.quote: And then they changed the name of the region from being just Utopia to Galaxis Chaos.

plain: In the 1980s, after a second face-like shape was found on the surface of Mars, the region it sat in was renamed from "Utopia" to "Galaxias Chaos." That is what the physicist John Brandenburg says, speaking from his own involvement in the research. Brandenburg argues that life on Mars was destroyed in a nuclear war, and he does not say who made the name change.
